listing.name: Vanilla Portrait Remaster
listing.summary: This mod is a complete, high-fidelity visual overhaul of 216 base game human character, player and faction portraits. The vanilla designs have been remastered to look sharper and more detailed, while keeping with the original portrait's overall appearance.
listing.aiSummary: Replaces 216 base game human character, player, and faction portraits with high-fidelity, manually edited versions.

description:
[0.98a] Vanilla Portrait Remaster v1.0.0

This mod is a complete, high-fidelity visual overhaul of 216 base game human character, player and faction portraits. The vanilla designs have been remastered to look sharper and more detailed, while keeping with the original portrait's overall appearance.

All images are downscaled from high resolution masters, to 256x256 pixels, using Lanczos resampling.

Asset Disclosure:
The base lighting, composition, and raw textures for these portraits were generated using Nano Banana 2. The original vanilla portraits were used as direct visual references for each new image. Portraits were then manually edited, corrected and polished by hand with Paint.NET to fix errors or alter the final result.

Click to view the full portrait showcase grid

(The preview image is a lower resolution than the in-game portraits)

Download from Google Drive

Installation:
1. Download and extract the ZIP file.
2. Drop the main folder directly into your Starsector/mods/ directory.
3. Enable "Vanilla Portrait Remaster" in the game launcher mod list.

I hadn't planned on releasing these as a mod, but I was so happy with how they turned out. Thought that others might enjoy them, as I have. ;D

Also, I didn't alter the AI portraits, as I feel they look better being a little grainy and lower resolution. If there is enough interest, I can do so by personal request. But they won't become part of this mod.
